phases.objective: Permit Staging live certification to accept a narrowly defined immutable portable artifact integrity proof when no tracked checkout exists, while preserving the generic runtime integrity classifier's fail-closed degraded state and requiring exact commit, tree, context-file-set, image, provenance, read-only and no-mutation evidence.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The Staging certifier accepts either a fully verified tracked checkout or the exact immutable portable-artifact proof, and rejects extra runtime integrity reasons, image drift, tracked mutation, missing provenance, missing identity, unexpected checkout state, or secret-bearing manifests without changing generic runtimeIntegrity behavior.
steps: Read the existing runtime_integrity and immutable application deployment manifest from the Staging deployment-info response.
Evaluate the bounded immutable-artifact proof only when generic runtime integrity is degraded solely because artifact content cannot be verified without a checkout.
Require exact expected commit, tree, context-file-set SHA-256 and image digest together with portable Staging build and git-archive provenance markers.

Require provenance_verified=true, identity_verified=true, content_verified=false, no checkout/readback, no tracked mutation, read_only_check=true and exactly one reason code: runtime_artifact_content_unverified.
Treat runtime_integrity_verified as satisfied only by the existing tracked-checkout verified state or the complete immutable-artifact proof.
Report verification_mode and the individual immutable-artifact checks without exposing credentials or secret material.
assertions: runtimeIntegrity.js remains unchanged and generic artifact-only runtimes remain degraded and fail closed.
An immutable artifact cannot satisfy certification without an exact expected sha256 image digest.
Any additional reason code or tracked-file mutation fails the immutable-artifact proof.
The application manifest must be secret-free and identify portable_staging_docker_build with git_archive_exact_commit tree and context sources.
No database, provider, Production, migration, grant, replay-store or credential mutation is introduced.
